commit.message:
Inline stack icons and simplify Radar component

Move stack icon data into the index page and render the stack icon grid inline there; remove the Radar component's static icon list and markup (Radar.astro now only contains the chart scripts). Remove the Radar import and canvas from src/pages/index.astro, add a local `stack` array, and render the icon grid directly. Also move the Ascii component placement and add an opacity tweak for its styling. Minor UI tweak in src/pages/projects.astro: remove the bold font weight from repository name.

Refactor social links into mapped array
